{{Top|leg}}
The '''DarkStryder fire creature''' was a piece of [[DarkStryder technology]] employed by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mist (bounty hunter)|Mist]] on the [[alien construct]] within the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]]. Contained within a silver-white metallic cord, the fiery apparition was twenty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and twenty meters wide, and contained a monstrous face within its [[Fire/Legends|flames]]. The creature was immune to [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire, but it was only temporary, and dissipated after a few minutes. The creature was controlled by the cord, which Mist wore on her arm.
